headline: The Pakistan Army on Wednesday conducted a successful launch of the Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile, which ISPR says will boost the operational flexibility and strike range of the Army Rocket Force Command, Dawn reports.

card.desc: ISPR says it strikes distant targets with high precision

caption:
Pakistan successfully test-launches the Fatah-3 supersonic cruise missile! 🇵🇰
According to Dawn, the Pakistan Army launched the Fatah-3 on Wednesday, the military's media wing ISPR said. ISPR says the missile has advanced navigation and propulsion systems and can strike distant targets with high precision at supersonic speed, boosting the strike range of the Army Rocket Force Command. President Asif Ali Zardari, PM Shehbaz Sharif and Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir congratulated the team. In October, Pakistan tested the Fatah-IV cruise missile and the Fatah-2 extended-range missile.
